verdict.rationale: Speech is Cheap is itself an API product. It documents Jobs API endpoints for creating jobs, reading results, and checking auth and health, and probes confirm a live OpenAPI spec and llms.txt. It also publishes per-key scoping guidance and a versioning and deprecation policy. missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration of actual API calls (e.g., a recorded job creation or read against the Jobs API).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API
